app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

timeform.description: Set only with include=timeform and include=handicapping.

salary.description: Salary is the FanDuel DFS salary in dollars; Value is points per $1,000 of salary.

previous_american_odds.description:
PreviousAmericanOdds and PreviousDecimalOdds are the price immediately
before the current one, present once the price has moved.

PreviousAmericanOdds and PreviousDecimalOdds are the price immediately
before the current one, present once the price has moved. The Sportsbook
keeps a single previous price, not a series.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.
info.title: Crawlora API

get.description: Lists the FanDuel Casino lobby's public categories (slots, jackpots, blackjack, roulette, live dealer, exclusives and more) with the slug the `category` route takes. `region` picks the lobby: `mi` (default) is the Michigan lobby at casino.fanduel.com, which includes the Michigan-only MotorCity Favorites collection, and `on` is the Ontario lobby at casino.fanduel.ca, which has three Ontario-only collections and lacks Hot Slots, Classic Reels and Bonus Buy. The casino site serves one state's lobby to every address tried, so no other state is offered. The signed-in player's own favorites list is not a public category and is not included.

parameters.description: Lobby: `mi` Michigan (default) or `on` Ontario
parameters.name: region

get.description: Returns a page of a casino category's games in the lobby's own order, with each game's slug, name, studio, badge (`Exclusive`, `Jackpot`), whether it is flagged as a site-wide jackpot game, and a link to its page. `providers` and `badges` count the whole category so the values the `provider` and `badge` filters accept are always visible; `q` matches every word against the game name. `all-games`, `slots` and `double-your-bet-category` hold the whole catalog (about 3,800 games) in one 30MB page, so their first call is slow and the parsed list is then cached for 15 minutes.

parameters.description: Lobby: `mi` Michigan (default) or `on` Ontario
parameters.name: region

parameters.description: Category slug from the `categories` route for the same `region`. Michigan has `all-games`, `new`, `slots`, `double-your-bet-category`, `jackpots`, `daily-jackpots`, `hot-slots`, `classic-reels-category`, `bonus-buy-category`, `high-limit-category`, `spooky-slots-category`, `exclusives`, `pick-play`, `arcade`, `blackjack`, `baccarat`, `roulette`, `table`, `livecasino`, `online-casino-favorites`, `explore-videos`, `motorcity-favorites`; Ontario has the same list without `hot-slots`, `classic-reels-category`, `bonus-buy-category`, `online-casino-favorites` and `motorcity-favorites`, and adds `fallsview-favourites-category`, `the-wolf-den-category`, `sports-central`. A slug the lobby lacks returns `400`
parameters.name: category

parameters.description: Words to find in the game name, such as `huff puff`; every word must match
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Keep only games from this studio, exactly as listed in the response `providers` (for example `NYX`, `Evolution`, `IGT`); a value the category does not have returns `400`
parameters.name: provider

parameters.description: Keep only games with this badge, exactly as listed in the response `badges` (for example `Exclusive`, `Jackpot`)
parameters.name: badge

parameters.description: Games per page, 1 to 200; default 50
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Games to skip; default 0
parameters.name: offset

Slugs come from the `category` route; an unknown game returns 404.

parameters.description: Game slug from the `category` route (`games[].slug`), lower-case, such as `huff-n-even-more-puff-hard-hat-edition`

Needs a date, a track code and a race number from the `past-races` route; a race that did not run returns 404. A race whose results the service no longer holds returns no `results`.

get.description: Returns one race in full: its conditions, every entry with morning-line and current odds (fractional and decimal), recent price history, runners (jockey, trainer, owner, pedigree, weight, age, scratch and jockey-change flags, win probability), pool totals, probable payouts, will-pays for multi-race bets, the wagers it accepts with their limits, and, once it is official, the finish order and payoffs. Pools, probables and will-pays appear only when the track reports them (mostly official and Up Next races). Pass `include` to add optional groups: `handicapping` (speed, class, pace, jockey-trainer record, power rating, career record and the favorite rank of every runner), `timeform` (Timeform analyst and production comments, tissue price, flags and, once official, how each finisher was beaten, its starting price and a post-race report) and `pool_grids` (the money bet on each entry's pairings in every pool, mostly once the race is official). A race that is not on today's card returns 404.

A sport with nothing featured (Women's Soccer and Sports Betting 101 on 2026-10-24) returns an empty list. The service has no homepage variant, so `sport` is required.

Games that have not finished also carry the Sportsbook event id, link and the money line, spread and total with the market and selection ids. `season_type` is `PRE`, `REGULAR` or `POST`; `week` is `0` to `4` for `PRE`, `1` to `18` for `REGULAR` and `1` to `5` for `POST`. A week with no games returns an empty list.
